 "description": "Covers the latest engineering principles necessary for building complex software systems that comply with recognized standards in the financial industry. Emphasizes software design. Seeks to help engineers construct complex software from a sophisticated engineering perspective. Examines how to put together cutting-edge organizational systems that people in the financial world can put to good use.
